title: Battle of Ahmed Khel
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Ahmed Khel", at revision 1374798329, opens: "The Battle of Ahmed Khel took place during the Second Anglo-Afghan War. It was fought on 19 April 1880, on the road between Kandahar and Kabul in central Afghanistan between Afghan tribesmen and soldiers of the British Empire, including forces from both British and Indian armies." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4870232, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1880 battle of the Second Anglo-Afghan War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
